description: Run one endpoint and return its JSON response. Spends the endpoint's credits from the user's balance on success only; failed calls are free. Pass parameters exactly as get_endpoint lists them (array parameters as JSON arrays). The result reports credits used and remaining. Errors come back with a code: invalid_parameters (fix the parameters and retry), not_found (no data for these parameters), rate_limited or temporarily_unavailable (wait and retry), insufficient_credits, restricted_endpoint (the user must accept the restricted-endpoint terms in their dashboard), invalid_api_key (the MCP server config needs a valid API key). Responses over 100,000 characters are truncated; use paging or limit parameters to fetch less.
name: call_endpoint
title: Call a data endpoint
